about.title: Built to help people reconnect with nature
text: Ernesto Fernandez is the founder and principal of Fernandez Landscape Contractors Services, and his passion for outdoor living comes from wanting to help people reconnect to nature wherever they can.
For more than 20 years the company has offered a full range of landscaping services in Houston and the surrounding areas.
Landscaping, drainage, irrigation, pavers and patio covers can be one project with one team, and they have handled HOA approvals and permits before.
Their most important value is customer service: prompt, open communication and honesty.
